data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this modern 1-bedroom apartment for rent in The Crest Tower B, Sobha Hartland.
.
Located on a low floor, this unfurnished residence offers a smart and functional layout, quality finishing, and a pleasant community view, making it an ideal home for professionals or couples seeking premium living in a well-connected community.

Unit Details:

⦁ Type: 1 Bedroom Apartment
⦁ Bathrooms: 1
⦁ Size: 513.65 sqft
⦁ Floor: Low Floor
⦁ View: Community View
⦁ Furnishing: Unfurnished (With Kitchen Appliances)
⦁ Living Area: Bright open-plan living and dining area with large windows
⦁ Kitchen: Modern fitted kitchen equipped with appliances
⦁ Bedroom: Spacious bedroom with built-in wardrobes
⦁ Balcony: Private balcony overlooking the community
⦁ Parking: 1 Allocated Parking Space
⦁ Status: Ready to Move

Building Amenities – The Crest Tower B:

⦁ Lagoon-style Swimming Pool
⦁ Fully Equipped Gymnasium
⦁ Children’s Play Area
⦁ Landscaped Gardens and Outdoor Leisure Areas
⦁ BBQ Area
⦁ Yoga and Relaxation Zones
⦁ 24/7 Security & Concierge Services
⦁ Covered Parking
⦁ High-speed Elevators

Prime Location – Sobha Hartland (MBR City):

⦁ Located in Sobha Hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City
⦁ Minutes from Downtown Dubai and Business Bay
⦁ Easy access to Al Khail Road and major highways
⦁ Close to international schools, parks, and retail outlets
⦁ Premium waterfront community surrounded by greenery and walkways
